grey_snap_ms.description: Delay before a greyed run auto-advances. Zero means the cursor snaps; anything above ~60 makes the player wait on the game.

min_stage1_coverage.description: If measured stage-1 live coverage falls below this, the curriculum boundaries must move. Hard floor.

gate_accuracy.description: Accuracy required on a stage's new keys to advance.

gate_window.description: Trailing window the gate is measured over.

gate_latency_base_ms.description: Median keystroke latency allowed at stage 0.

gate_latency_step_ms.description: Tightening per stage. This is the anti-hunt-and-peck lever.

idle_base_ms.description: Silence before the blot-cloud approaches, at stage 0. Generous on purpose.

idle_floor_ms.description: Never less than this, at any stage.

cloud_approach_ms.description: Telegraph time between the cloud appearing and it striking.

cloud_smudge.description: Smudge added when the cloud lands.

smudge_max.description: Full meter. Reaching it costs one heart and resets.

smudge_per_error_base.description: Added per mistyped key at stage 0.

smudge_per_error_step.description: Added per stage, so tolerance narrows as skill grows.

smudge_decay_per_key.description: Removed per correct keystroke. Clean typing cleans the page.

combo_tempo_max.description: Music tempo multiplier at maximum combo.

rail_cursor_x.description: Cursor position across the viewport. Must never vary.

rail_scroll_lerp.description: Text ribbon easing per frame toward its target offset.

focal_guide_width.description: Width of the rules above and below the cursor.

warp_echo_hold_ms.description: How long the shared phrase stays lit while the world changes.

lectio_ramp_wpm.description: How fast Lectio accelerates while sustained.

candle_interval.description: Checkpoint spacing, so death costs a verse or two, never a chapter.

bonus_word_chance.description: Chance a verse offers a side-platform bonus word.

audio_default_on.description: Audio starts muted. Browsers block autoplay and a beginner does not need a surprise.

wpm_chars_per_word.description: The standard definition of a "word" for WPM. Do not change; it makes scores incomparable.

history_max_sessions.description: How much practice history is retained locally.
